title: France demands belt-tightening in 2027 budget as investors sour on its debt
summary: France presented its ​2027 budget bill on Thursday, seeking to enact unpopular belt-tightening measures that can lower its deficit and appease increasingly twitchy bond investors ahead of next year's presidential election.
